title.zh: 品牌设计／从方向到触点

statement.zh: Hermès、Arc’teryx、Periastra 与夜礼司：以方向、识别和应用规则组织品牌体验，记录团队协作与公开交付边界。
statement.en: Hermès, Arc’teryx, Periastra and Yelisi: connect direction, identity and application rules while recording team collaboration and public delivery boundaries.

role.zh: 方向研究／VI/UI 协作／视觉呈现
role.en: Direction studies / VI/UI collaboration / Visual presentation

title.zh: 产品设计／实体与数字体验

statement.zh: 从灯具、个护与服务产品，到彼源 AI 和数字工具；以场景、形态、信息结构与操作流程组织完整产品体验。
statement.en: From lighting, personal-care and service concepts to Biyuan AI and digital tools, connect scenarios, form, information structure and interaction.

role.zh: 产品方向／形态与 CMF／VI/UI 与交互协作
role.en: Product direction / Form & CMF / VI/UI & interaction collaboration

title.zh: 杭州理灵／品牌、产品与项目统筹
title.en: Hangzhou Liling / Brand, product & project coordination

summary.zh: 负责彼源 AI 整体 VI/UI 设计与迭代；参与 Periastra 品牌图形与应用研究及夜礼司品牌视觉与产品概念共同创作。页面归属、上线责任、团队规模与商业结果按证据边界说明。
summary.en: Responsible for Biyuan AI’s overall VI/UI design and iteration; contributed collaboratively to Periastra brand-graphic and application research and Yelisi brand-visual and product-concept work. Page attribution, launch responsibility, team size and commercial outcomes remain bounded by the available evidence.

summary.zh: 在 Hermès 与 Arc’teryx 橱窗项目中参与三维设计与视觉呈现；团队规模、个人统筹、法国沟通、工厂生产和门店展示边界待核验。参与铝型材灯具设计与三维表达。
summary.en: Contributed to 3D design and visual presentation on Hermès and Arc’teryx windows; team size, individual leadership, France communication, factory production and store-display boundaries remain unverified. Also contributed to aluminum lighting design and visualization.

title.zh: 瀚宇博德／制造与设计系统

summary.zh: 在 PCB 制造环境中接触标准化、工程约束、质量要求与跨部门协同。公开档案不包含客户板件、Gerber、内部 SOP 或工艺参数。
summary.en: Worked within a PCB manufacturing environment shaped by standardization, engineering constraints, quality requirements and cross-functional coordination. The public record excludes customer boards, Gerber files, internal SOPs and process parameters.

title.zh: 湖南欧音文化传媒／用户与交互支持
title.en: Hunan Ouyin Culture & Media / User & interaction support

summary.zh: 参与市场调研、用户反馈整理和交互原型设计，协助团队把需求转化为可讨论、可迭代的体验方案。
summary.en: Contributed to market research, user feedback synthesis and interaction prototypes, helping the team turn requirements into tangible proposals.

title.zh: AI 与开源／把判断写进工具
title.en: AI and open source / Put judgment into tools

role.zh: 独立实践与开源二次开发
role.en: Independent practice and open-source derivative work

summary.zh: 从输入、证据、差异审核到恢复机制，把设计判断变成可操作流程，并清楚说明继承与新增的边界。
summary.en: Turned design judgment into operable flows from input and evidence to diff review and recovery, while stating inherited and added work clearly.

title.zh: 产品设计／使用、形态与 CMF

role.zh: 产品设计本科与合作概念项目
role.en: Product-design education and collaborative concept projects

summary.zh: 从角色与任务出发，用草图、部件、形态模型及 CMF 说明选择，连接实体产品、服务关系与界面。
summary.en: Start with people and tasks, using sketches, components, form models and CMF to explain decisions across products, service relationships and interfaces.

retained.zh: 保留上游简历解析、编辑与排版工作台的基础。
retained.en: Retains the upstream résumé parsing, editing and layout workspace foundation.

contribution.zh: 扩展岗位版与主版本对照、证据片段、局部改写、差异审核、拒绝与撤销路径。
contribution.en: Extends job/master version comparison, evidence excerpts, local rewrites, diff review, reject and undo paths.

result.zh: 形成可操作的本地工作台与对应案例记录，并以行为测试验证恢复与审核状态。
result.en: Produced an operable local workspace and case record, with behavior tests covering recovery and review states.

boundary.zh: 基于 MIT 上游的个人二次开发，不代表上游官方产品。
boundary.en: An individual MIT-licensed derivative; not an official upstream product.

retained.zh: 复用上游工资模拟的核心计算与开源许可边界。
retained.en: Reuses the upstream salary-simulation core and its open-source license boundary.

contribution.zh: 独立组织小程序端的入门、首页、主题、日历与详情体验，并整理原生运行记录。
contribution.en: Independently organizes mini-program onboarding, home, themes, calendar and detail experiences, with native run records.

result.zh: 形成可运行的独立小程序实践与页面证据，用于说明移动端交互和主题系统能力。
result.en: Produced an independent runnable mini-program practice and page evidence for mobile interaction and theming capability.

boundary.zh: 遵循 AGPL-3.0-only；不是 PayDance 上游的官方小程序版本。
boundary.en: Follows AGPL-3.0-only and is not an official PayDance mini-program release.

title.zh: 品牌识别与 VI/UI 系统

summary.zh: 从定位、标志规则到界面层级和跨载体应用。
summary.en: From positioning and identity rules to interface hierarchy and applications.

title.zh: 方向、团队协作与交付边界

summary.zh: 分析整体设计稿、团队评审、制作语境与展示关系；个人生产和现场责任按证据边界说明。
summary.en: Analyze design proposals, team review, production context and display relationships; individual production and site responsibility remain evidence-bounded.

summary.zh: 用场景、比例、部件与模型解释产品设计选择。
summary.en: Explain product decisions through scenarios, proportion, components and models.

summary.zh: 把 VI/UI、编辑、确认、差异与恢复连接为可操作的产品。
summary.en: Connect VI/UI, editing, confirmation, differences and recovery into usable products.
